meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: MUST USE after building/changing any UI or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Rigorous visual QA across web/page and terminal UIs. Prefer browser:control-in-app-browser for unauthenticated browser/page QA in Codex, then Playwright/agent-browser/dev-browser. Captures screenshot/TUI evidence with bundled diff scripts, runs design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK reviewer passes, then synthesizes a good/bad verdict. Triggers: visual QA, screenshot/pixel diff, UI looks wrong, reference fidelity, design system check, responsive check, CJK text clipping, TUI alignment, box-drawing drift.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动检查UI和终端界面的视觉正确性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次改完UI都要手动截图对比像素差异
copy.tagline_en: Automatically verify visual correctness of UI and terminal interfaces
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manually compare screenshots after every UI change

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在你构建或修改任何用户界面后，自动进行严格的视觉质量检查。它会截取屏幕截图，运行两个独立的审查流程，然后给出“通过”或“需要修改”的结论。
howto.when: 当你构建或修改了网页界面或终端界面，并声称完成时触发。也适用于你怀疑界面有回归问题、CJK 文字显示异常，或需要与设计稿对比时。

say.text: 帮我检查这个新页面和设计稿是否一致。
say.note: Claude 会截取截图并运行审查。

say.text: 这个终端布局的边框对齐吗？
say.note: Claude 会检查终端界面是否有溢出或错位。

say.text: 检查一下这个组件的设计系统一致性。
say.note: Claude 会验证样式是否使用了可复用的设计令牌。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will automatically perform a rigorous visual quality check whenever you build or modify any UI. It captures screenshots, runs two independent review passes, and then gives a pass or revise verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you build or modify a web or terminal UI and claim it is done. Also when you suspect a regression, CJK text display issues, or need to compare against a design mockup.

say_en.text: Check if this new page matches the design mockup.
say_en.note: Claude will capture screenshots and run reviews.

say_en.text: Is the terminal layout border aligned?
say_en.note: Claude will check for overflow or misalignment.

say_en.text: Check the design system consistency of this component.
say_en.note: Claude will verify styles use reusable design tokens.
